package.name: cat_arena
package.description: Module 1 of the Caterpillar Autonomy Challenge stack: the seeded arena. Generates a Gazebo Harmonic world (9 x 5 m, 30 cm tilled dry sand) with a real crater-bearing terrain mesh, collidable walls, visual-only zone markings, ground-truth obstacle placement (>=3 boulders, >=3 craters), fiducial marker boards, a ground-truth file for tests/labels only, and a launch file that spawns the rover at a random pose inside the start zone.
